label: bug
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The issue with the Export button staying greyed out after a failed export is due to the busy state not being reset when the exportReport function throws an error. Currently, the setBusy(false) call is only executed after a successful export, inside the .then() callback.

To fix this, the error should be caught, and setBusy(false) should be called in a .catch() block or using async/await with try/catch around exportReport(). Additionally, showing an error toast message to inform the user would improve UX. This will ensure that the Export button is re-enabled after a failed export, allowing the user to try again without reloading the page.
